summary: iter_14 verified Phase A (lifespan migration + AddAssetModal validation UX + stale test cleanup) and Phase D (new backend endpoints: PATCH/DELETE /goals/{id}, GET /assets/{id}, extended /finance; new frontend screens: /goals, /asset/[id], portfolio-tap navigation, profile 'Active goals' section, finance 'Revenue mix' + 'Expense breakdown' + '90d fcst' range). Created /app/backend/tests/test_v14_goals_asset_finance.py — 22 new tests, 100% PASS. Regression: v10 (25) + v12 (15) + v13 (25) still 100% PASS. Total backend: 87/87 in ~56s. Frontend smoke via Playwright (mobile 390×844, audit-token synth session): portfolio→asset detail nav works (hero score 91, 4 KPI grid, Top 1% Benchmark, back-btn), profile→manage-goals→/goals works (summary 4/0/66%, 4 goal cards), add-goal modal inline validation all three errors surface correctly ('Title is required', 'Target must be a positive number', 'Deadline must be YYYY-MM-DD'), valid goal creation persists to list, Finance tab shows 'Revenue mix' with 6 mix-<id> rows, 'Expense' breakdown, range-90d-fcst button switches to dashed forecast subtitle 'Forward projection · dashed = forecast'; AddAssetModal shows asset-name-error on empty submit and revenue input filter strips '-' from '-5' → '5' as spec'd. Backend deprecation check: /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log has 0 occurrences of 'on_event' — lifespan migration verified clean. NO BUGS FOUND. All spec items from the review request behave exactly as described.
action_items: None required. All Phase A polish + Phase D new feature spec items verified working end-to-end.
OPTIONAL carryover from iter_12/13 (P2, non-blocking): GET /api/billing/paypal/status still lacks Depends(current_user). Not in scope for iter_14.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:61-67 — @asynccontextmanager lifespan correctly awaits ensure_indexes on startup and calls client.close() on shutdown. FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan) wired at line 70. Deprecation warning eliminated (verified via log grep = 0 hits).

server.py:594-624 — GoalUpdate uses Optional fields with server-side guardrails BEFORE the DB update: empty title→400, title>120→413, current<0→400, target≤0→400, unknown/cross-user→404. All six paths covered by pytest.
server.py:627-632 — DELETE checks deleted_count for idempotent 404 — second delete correctly returns 404.
server.py:636-679 — /assets/{id} scopes on {id, user_id}, returns full detail (asset+content+recs+benchmarks+kpis). Cross-user returns 404 (verified via v14-other-asset test).

server.py:493-578 — /finance new fields: by_asset sorted desc by revenue_mtd (verified), by_platform aggregation from asset docs, expense_categories = 5 fixed items summing to 100% share, projection = 90-day forward list with date/revenue/expense, summary.forecast_90d = profit*3.31. All fields present and shape-correct.

AddAssetModal.tsx:43-61 — errors memo recomputes on name/revenue/followers change. canSubmit gates on Object.keys(errors).length===0. shouldShow requires touched[field] — good UX (won't yell before user interacts). onSubmit force-marks all touched so hidden errors surface.

AddAssetModal.tsx:192,210 — TextInput onChangeText strips non-digit chars via regex, so '-' cannot be typed into revenue/followers fields. Verified in browser: typing '-5' resulted in '5' in the DOM value.
goals.tsx:295-329 — Client-side validation for create/edit mirrors backend (title required, target>0, current>=0, deadline regex). Deadline regex ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$ catches '2026/12/31' as spec'd.
goals.tsx:144-156 — onLongPress triggers Alert.alert confirm→api.deleteGoal→reload. Standard Expo pattern.
Stale test files v1-v9 confirmed removed — /app/backend/tests/ contains only v10, v12, v13, v14.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke — every spec'd flow (portfolio→asset, profile→goals, goal CRUD validation, finance revenue-mix + 90d fcst, AddAssetModal validation) verified via Playwright + screenshots
